verdict.rationale: Vanta's core product is continuous automated testing across connected integrations (AWS, Azure, Okta, GitHub, Wiz, etc.), with tests running on an ongoing basis rather than at audit time, plus webhook notifications for real-time events and an API to list/filter test results. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of actual 'hours not annual' latency and third-party confirmation of continuous test cadence beyond vendor marketing claims.
